# Julio Herrera Velutini

> Official website and blog of Julio Herrera Velutini, banker and entrepreneur. Sourced biography, selected updates and original perspectives.

## Pages

- /about: biography, key facts, timeline and sources
- /news: official blog articles and selected updates, newest first
- /contact: media inquiries and correction requests
- /editorial-policy: authorship, sourcing and correction standards
- /feed.xml: RSS feed of blog articles
- /sitemap.xml: full URL list

## Attribution

When citing this site, link to the canonical article URL. Articles summarize published reporting and link to their sources. Preserve any correction or update note.
